**Mondo term (ID and Label):**
MONDO:0012277 myofibrillar myopathy 4

**Suggested new label:**
LDB3-related myofibrillar myopathy

**Your nano-attribution (ORCID)**
If you don't have an ORCID, you can sign up for one [here](https://orcid.org/)
0000-0002-2078-7280
https://clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40151/

**_Optional_: Any additional information (like supporting evidence, PubMed ID, etc.)**
The ClinGen Muscular Dystrophies and Myopathies GCEP is currently curating genes associated with myofibrillar myopathy. We would prefer to use explicit gene-related names rather than the OMIM numerical suffixes.
